Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have a shared plan going into pilot review: 

Summary of what we heard
- Pilot scope: 2 internal-facing workflows (claims triage + eligibility lookup), 3-week initial run, up to 10k requests/day during peak.
- Primary decision criteria: throughput/latency under 200ms p95, clear audit trail for requests, and explicit data retention controls.
- Key committee: Tom Walters (CTO / economic buyer), Priya Singh (Head of Legal), Jordan Ellis (Product lead), Procurement (Procurement inbox).

Immediate asks we committed to
1) Deliver SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) + pen-test summary.
2) Provide a sample of audit logs and a short note on retention controls.
3) Fill procurement template and confirm SOW cadence.

Proposed dates
- Wed 21 Apr: Share artifacts (SOC2, pen test, audit log sample, data retention note) — see attachments/Drive link below.
- Fri 23 Apr: 30-min follow-up with Tom to align on SLAs and decision criteria.
- Tue 27 Apr: Procurement receives draft SOW / pricing sheet.

Links / artifacts
- Shared folder (read-only): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/bluepeak-pilot-artifacts
- Procurement template: attachment (procurement_template_bluepeak.xlsx)

If that schedule works I can lock the follow-up with Tom — Marissa, I’m looping you as we may need executive support for the SLA ask if they push on uptime guarantees.

Thanks,
Priyom

Jordan — thanks, attached and inline answers below. Deliverables are in the Drive link and attached to this email (redacted SOC2, pen test summary, sample audit log csv, data retention note).

Short answers to your items
- SOC 2 scope: the attached SOC2_Type2_Redacted_2026.pdf covers our hosted API (control plane + runtime as operated in our hosted environment). The report includes control mappings for access control, change management, and logging.
- Pen test: pen_test_summary_2026.pdf is a summary of a third-party assessment of our runtime and orchestration layers; it contains an executive summary and remediation status (no high-risk open items).
- Audit logs & retention: attached audit_log_sample.csv shows the event format (timestamps, request id, model id, requesting token id). Data retention is configurable — for pilots we typically offer 90 days by default; longer retention and e-discovery can be negotiated (see data_retention_policy_2027.docx).
- Pricing note: For the 3-week pilot we estimate 0.5–0.8M tokens total; suggested pilot package is a capped-run monthly price + overage at usage tier. I uploaded a completed procurement_template_bluepeak.xlsx with estimated run-rate and a sample SOW outline.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Priya: can you confirm whether the SOC2 + pen test artifacts are sufficient to proceed to Tom and Procurement? If you need specific control mappings (e.g., encryption-at-rest key management proof), Monica (cc'd) can provide the KMS/HSM details.
- Jordan: if the artifacts look good, please propose 2 windows for an alignment call with Tom next week (we have availability Thu 22 Apr 09:00–12:00 PT or Fri 23 Apr 11:00–14:00 PT).
- Procurement: we provided the filled template — please let me know if you need an invoice-friendly quote or PO language up front.

Attachments included:
- SOC2_Type2_Redacted_2026.pdf (pdf)
- pen_test_summary_2026.pdf (pdf)
- audit_log_sample.csv (csv)
- data_retention_policy_2027.docx (docx)
- procurement_template_bluepeak.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — I’ll standby for Priya / Procurement confirmation and will block the suggested slots once Jordan confirms.

Best,
Priyom
